description: An expected list writes each test with notation operators and canonical output tags, with spaces only around ∪, and with its value in canonical form: a string in quotes with \ and " escaped, a tag set as ∅, its one tag or its tags in code point order in parentheses, and a constant as its value. The list is in code point order: ∩ is U+2229, ≠ U+2260, ⊇ U+2287 and ⊉ U+2289 (docs/output.md).
grammar:
%const $AB B ∪ ~a ∪ A
%rule text X⊇$AB | X∩'b'≠∅ | X≠"a\"b\\" | X⊉∅ | X∩~w=∅ | X⊇(A ∪ A)
